name: Document scanner: DXScanner
summary:
Needs to send documents? No problem, scan photos and documents, convert in PDF and share it.

Transform your Meta Quest device into a document scanner and converter!

- Scan any document, photo, or page using your Meta Quest camera;
- Create PDF from your scans;
- Easily export your files in digital format.

# Key Features:

- Scanner for documents and photos
- Quick image-to-PDF conversion
- Simple file export to cloud or via email
- Intuitive interface for easy document management
